prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Universe", "Discover how your companion lives right on your desktop. Choose how you want to interact and start your journey."]
1: ["Select Pet Photo", "Companion Rendering Preview"]
2: ["Sign in to securely sync and restore your pets across all desktop installs.", "Continue & Sync Pets"]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "Checking display permissions and rendering overlay to ensure your companion appears seamlessly on top of windows."]
4: ["Pick Your Companion Path", "Choose how your pet will assist you. Don't worry—you can switch your path anytime in settings.", "You can change paths later without losing progress."]
5: ["For best pet rendering results, upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward with minimal background clutter."]
6: ["Your companion is being brought to life on your desktop. This usually takes under 3 minutes."]
7: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "Use Ctrl+Pet to open controls, double-click to interact, or right-click to hide your pet anytime."]
8: ["All companions & items included free on all paths!"]
9: []
